requiredBehaviors.behavior: use the final fidelity-approved report as the only content basis
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Document rendering starts only from the fidelity-approved final report and does not re-author content.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: route EUROIMMUN output through the existing EUROIMMUN DOCX and PDF renderers
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The renderer selection explicitly routes EUROIMMUN context to the existing EUROIMMUN DOCX and PDF skills.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: treat DOCX as the canonical editable layout source and derive PDF consistently
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The delivery architecture defines DOCX as canonical and derives PDF from the same final layout/content basis.
Both DOCX and PDF require visual checks for pagination, tables, links, glyphs and headers/footers before final delivery.
